proposition: The single letter on MS Majlis 10196 f. 148a may be three: Dānishpazhūh reads one sent to Niʿmat Allāh Valī as dictated by Iskandar and two from Ibn Turka asking Niʿmat Allāh Valī to intercede with Shāhrukh; MK counts one letter, so what Ibn Turka asked of Niʿmat Allāh Valī is disputed between the two readings.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
mediation.note: A dispute between Dānishpazhūh and MK reported in a footnote
